stumbles.quote: The two judges labelled 58 of the 63 as legitimate prose: the cells held numbers and labels, not sentences.
stumbles.why: The text never says who or what the "two judges" are. "Legitimate prose" also contradicts the clause after the colon, which says the cells weren't sentences. I can't tell whether the 58 hits were false positives or real ones.

stumbles.quote: I ran the linter over 41 published posts and got 300 hits.
stumbles.why: The text never says what the linter looks for or what counts as a "hit". "declaude" is unexplained. Without that, I can't judge whether table hits are noise.

stumbles.quote: `--skip-quoted` already blanks table cells, along with blockquotes and italics.
stumbles.why: The flag is introduced as if I already knew it. The text doesn't say how it is activated or how it differs in detail. It also doesn't say why `--skip-tables` should exist alongside it, beyond the italics case.

stumbles.quote: blanks every line that starts with `|`
stumbles.why: The text calls the target "Markdown tables" and "table cells". Tables without a leading pipe, or indented ones, aren't covered, and the text doesn't say whether that is intended.

point: The PR adds a `--skip-tables` flag to the declauding linter that blanks lines starting with `|`, so table cells aren't flagged and line numbers stay correct, and it exists separately from `--skip-quoted` so italics are still linted.
